reasons.text: Buys feedstock inside a closed loop of 5 recyclers trading the same material (26% of its feedstock)
Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 89% of months
Uploaded plant photos are near-duplicates of photos registered by 1 other plant(s)
Category III share of certificates is 48%, +46% versus what its process route can produce
In 100% of months, product sales fall far short of the claimed input
22% of purchase invoices have suspiciously round tonnages (typical plant: about 2%)

inspection_checklist: Trace the material flow between the plants in the loop (weighbridge slips, vehicle GPS); the same tonnes may be invoiced round a ring.
Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Compare the plant against the entities sharing its identifiers (bank, address, director, photos); consider a joint inspection.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
Reconcile product sales with processed tonnes; contact the product buyers listed and verify that they received the material.
Physically verify a sample of purchase invoices with the sellers (weighbridge slips, e-way bills, vehicle logs).
